title: OpenCode – Open source AI coding agent

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if your code wrote itself?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenSource AI is changing how we code — and it's already on Hacker News with 987 points.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenCode is an AI coding agent that writes, debugs, and optimizes code in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses a unique self-learning model trained on 10 million open-source projects.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers, startups, and coders everywhere can automate repetitive tasks and focus on creativity.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just faster — it’s smarter, and it’s here now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to see the future of coding? Follow me and I’ll show you how.
